headline: Oscar Health Flashes Buy Signal As Medicaid Weighs On Centene
summary: S&P 500 health insurer Centene blew away Q2 earnings forecasts amid lower-than-expected Affordable Care Act Marketplace benefit costs.  Oscar Health, a pure play on the ACA, flashed an early entry buy signal amid Centene's good news and a big price target hike.

headline: S&P 500 Stock Centene Dives On Medicaid Outlook
summary: S&P 500 health insurer Centene blew away Q2 earnings forecasts amid lower-than-expected Affordable Care Act Marketplace benefit costs.  CNC stock initially moved higher, but shares reversed sharply lower as the company discussed its outlook, including slightly higher Medicaid attrition and a more costly covered population in the second half of 2026.  Centene posted Q2 earnings of $2.51 a share, crushing forecasts of $1.09 by $1.42 a share.

headline: Wells Fargo Maintains Equal-Weight on Molina Healthcare, Lowers Price Target to $220
summary: Wells Fargo  analyst Stephen Baxter   maintains Molina Healthcare (NYSE:MOH) with a Equal-Weight and lowers the price target from $235 to $220.
